text:
caroline: Quick sync — launching webinar + benchmark blog next Wed. Need SEO handoff: keywords, schema snippets, redirects, and internal hub links. Goal: organic landing + gated signups.

matt: Thanks. Can we split into two tracks? 1) launch post + webinar page canonicalization, 2) benchmark narrative + case study landing. Different keyword sets.

caroline: yes. Track owners: matt on launch copy/schema, kevin on keyword mapping + silo, jun for dev redirects and canonical checks, olivia on lead routing/UTMs.

kevin: I'll run a light KW survey this morning. Target intent buckets: "low latency inference", "cost-optimized LLM serving", "dedicated GPU inference" — will propose 12 priorities.

matt: For schema I suggest using Event + FAQ + Article on the webinar page; Article for the benchmark blog. We should include timeZone, startDate, registrationURL (UTM). Example snippet for event registration:

jun: posting the snippet I'll implement — pls confirm field names.

matt: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmark Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-01T16:00:00-07:00",
  "url": "https://redwood.example.com/webinar-launch?utm_campaign=launch-apr",
  "offers": {"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.example.com/register"}
}
```

caroline: Perfect. Jun — for redirects we only need a short-lived mapping for old paths we might reuse in docs. Minimal and safe.

jun: I'll make a small redirect plan. Proposed rules:

```
# rewrite rules (NGINX)
rewrite ^/old-bench(/.*)?$ /benchmarks/launch$1 permanent;
rewrite ^/webinar-old$ /webinars/launch-2026 permanent;
```

jun: Will also add canonical tags to the blog templates to avoid duplication.

olivia: For lead routing — please append utm_source=webinar + utm_campaign variables. We need to ensure the form maps to Sales queue "Launch APAC" or "Launch NAM" based on region selection. I'll attach mapping table in the doc.

caroline: Good call. For internal linking: make a hub on /resources/llm-inference with links to benchmark, docs on dedicated vs hosted, and an FAQ anchor. Keep the hub depth 2.

kevin: I'll produce the internal linking anchor map. My quick idea: hub -> benchmark -> benchmark deep-dive -> cost calc -> signup. Anchor text should use exact-match KW once, then variations.

matt: Small SEO hygiene asks: add hreflang only if we publish translations; ensure open graph tags include primary keyword; compress images and lazy-load.

caroline: Timeline: KW list & link map by EOD today. Schema + event snippet by tomorrow EOD. Redirect PR by Friday. Launch dry-run next Tue.

jun: On it — I'll open a PR for the redirects and canonical fixes. deploy-bot will run link checker on staging.

deploy-bot: link-checker: started scan for https://staging.redwood.example.com/webinars/launch-2026 — 0 critical broken links, 3 warnings (images lazy-load missing). See /ci/reports/link-check-2555

olivia: I'll draft UTM mapping spreadsheet and share with sales for queue logic.

matt: One more — can we add a small code block with the benchmark CLI call in the blog? e.g.,

```bash
redwood-bench --model rwd-7b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --runs 10
```

caroline: yes. Make it non-executable note: sample only. Okay folks — owners: matt (schema + blog copy), kevin (KW + anchor map), jun (redirects + canonical PR), olivia (UTM & routing). Report back in this thread with PR links.

kevin: KW list shared: https://docs.example.com/sheets/kw-launch-2555 — feedback welcome.

jun: PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/www/merge_requests/342 — includes NGINX rewrites + canonical tag update.

matt: Draft post: https://docs.example.com/drafts/launch-blog-2555 — will add code block and FAQ.

caroline: Great progress. Quick risk note: watch for duplicate content if we run the same summary on resource hub and blog — prefer the hub to link to canonical blog.

olivia: Shared UTM mapping + sales queue logic: https://docs.example.com/spreadsheets/utm-routing-2555

caroline: Thanks team — closing the loop here. If anything blocks, @caroline please ping on this thread. :rocket:
